Name: Gift Lens
Author: linono32569
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Gift Lens｜礼物手账[/b]
A simple gift preference overlay for Stardew Valley. Hover over an item in your backpack or chest to instantly see which villagers love, like, or dislike it.
一款简洁的星露谷礼物喜好查询 MOD。鼠标悬停在背包或箱子中的物品上，即可查看哪些 NPC 喜欢或讨厌该物品，无需额外操作。[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]GiftLens[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Load your save and hover over an item to view its gift preferences.[/*]
[/list]下载并解压，将
[code]GiftLens[/code]文件夹放入游戏的
[code]Mods[/code]目录。进入存档后，将鼠标悬停在物品上即可查看礼物喜好。

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Instant Gift Lookup:[/b] View NPC gift preferences by hovering over items.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Five Gift Categories:[/b] Loved, Liked, Neutral, Disliked, and Hated.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Modded NPC Support:[/b] Supports compatible characters from SVE and other mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Customizable Panel:[/b] Adjust position, width, font size, and spacing.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Pagination:[/b] Switch pages with PageUp / PageDown.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Walnut-Style UI:[/b] A warm, opaque wooden notebook design.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Bilingual Support:[/b] English and Simplified Chinese.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][color=#d4d4d8]主要功能[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]悬停查询：[/b] 鼠标悬停物品即可查看 NPC 喜好。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]五档分类：[/b] 最爱、喜欢、一般、不喜欢、讨厌。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]扩展角色：[/b] 支持 SVE 等 MOD 添加的兼容 NPC。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]自定义面板：[/b] 可调整位置、宽度、字号和行距。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]分页浏览：[/b] 使用 PageUp / PageDown 翻页。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]胡桃木风格：[/b] 温暖、简洁的深色原木手账界面。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]双语支持：[/b] 简体中文与英文。[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) — Optional, for in-game customization.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Inspired by the gift preference tooltip concept of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41453]GiftTooltip[/url]. Gift Lens is independently developed with its own interface and code.
Special thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI and GMCM developers, and the Stardew Valley modding community!
灵感来源于 GiftTooltip 的悬停礼物喜好查询功能。Gift Lens 为独立开发，拥有自己的代码和界面设计。
感谢 ConcernedApe、SMAPI 与 GMCM 开发者，以及星露谷 MOD 社区！[/color]

Manifest.Name: Gift Lens
Manifest.Description: An original walnut-ledger gift taste panel with five categories, flexible positioning and English/Chinese localization.
Manifest.Author: Gift Lens
